defs.def: an amount of money that has been saved or has been made available for a particular purpose 基金；专款

ex.s: However, according to a report by the World Wildlife Fund, tourists ____18____ (leave) over 1.3 billion tons of food waste last year, ____19____ accounted for about 8% of the total global gas release in 2024.
ex.t: 然而，根据世界自然基金会的一份报告，游客去年___18___（留下）超过13亿吨食物垃圾，___19___约占2024年全球气体排放总量的8%。

ex.s: Since 1934, better than half a billion dollars has gone into that Fund to purchase more than 5 million acres of habitat.
ex.t: 自1934年以来，超过5亿美元进入该基金，用于购买500多万英亩的栖息地。

ex.s: According to the World Wildlife Fund, the global black rhino population has dropped as low as 5500, giving the rhinos a “critically endangered” status.
ex.t: 根据世界自然基金会，全球黑犀牛数量已降至低至5500头，使犀牛处于极危状态。

ex.s: It will continue to work with the World Wildlife Fund.
ex.t: 它将继续与世界自然基金会合作。

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 每张鸭票所筹的每一美元中，约有98美分直接汇入候鸟保护基金，用于购置湿地和野生动物栖息地，并将其纳入国家野生动物保护区系统——这一事实确保了这片土地将受到保护，并为子孙后代所用。

ex.s: Inside the bags are necessities such as toothpaste, soap and socks, bought first with her pocket money and then through crowd funding.
ex.t: 袋子里面是牙膏、肥皂和袜子等必需品，最初是用她的零花钱买的，后来通过众筹。

defs.def: money that is available to be spent 资金；现款

ex.s: As quantum computing attracts more attention and funding, researchers may mislead investors, journalists, the public and, worst of all, themselves about their work’s potential.
ex.t: 随着量子计算吸引更多关注和资金，研究者可能误导投资者、记者、公众，最糟的是，误导他们自己关于工作潜力的认知。

ex.t: 他用捐赠的资金和自己的钱来支付英国政府要求的每个孩子50英镑的费用。

ex.s: The group asked for contributions from different departments and raised funds within the international community.
ex.t: 该小组向各部门征集捐款，并在国际社会筹集资金。
